title: Calligraphy L0-03 · ‎د ذ ر ز: letters that do not connect

blocks.text: Calligraphy L0-03 · ⁧د ذ ر ز⁩: letters that do not connect
⁧د⁩ dāl · d · /d/ Sound dental Occlusive. It's not connected to the next one.
⁧ذ⁩ ḏāl · ḏ · /ð/ Fricativa interdentale sonora: come ⁧ث⁩ But with a voice. It's not connected.
⁧ر⁩ rāʾ · r · /r/ Alveolar vibrating (usually at one beat). He's going down the line. It's not connected.
⁧ز⁩ zāy · z · /z/ Sound alveolar furicative: s of ...wrong, not z of ... It's not connected.
Words dār house, dwelling; ⁧دَار دَار دَار⁩ institution (names)
wazīr Minister ⁧وَزِير وَزِير وَزِير⁩ ḏanb guilt, sin ⁧ذَنْب ذَنْب ذَنْب⁩
